author: M J
text: Mr. Larry was great. He was efficient and timely. Fairly priced. He answered all my questions because we are new to owning a home with a septic tank. Gave me suggestions for the future and how to care for our tank. Thank you for coming out! Will absolutely recommend to anyone and will keep his number in my phone for the future.

author: Frank Taylor
text: Bond Septic was both professional and knowledgeable about his work. Did a complete job as scheduled and was very fair on pricing. I would highly recommend this service.

author: DaQuan Gunn
text: If I could rate 0 stars I would. I called for services and the person who answered refused to greet me back and then hung up the phone then proceeded to block my number. AWFUL SERVICE, EVEN MORE DISGUSTING ATTITUDE.

author: Curtis Lee
text: The technician was a gentleman, attentive and professional. Very fair price. He explained details of my system and how to address issues in the future. Highly recommended

author: Camy Merrell
text: Wow! They did such a great job. They noticed that our tank had a second area that had not been drained by our previous septic service and stayed longer to empty both sections at a lower price than the other company! They spent more time doing the job well at a lower cost. I would definitely call them back next time.
